page.overview:
Who is Daikoku Funeno?

When Sasuke enrolled at the Academy, Daikoku reminisces about Itachi's time as a student. He states that Itachi was the most gifted student he had ever had, and expected great things from Sasuke as well.

Daikoku is a fairly large man with brown hair and a goatee. He wears the standard uniform of the Konoha shinobi inclusive flak jacket and a forehead protector that he wears like a bandanna.

In the anime, after the power goes out in the village, he and several other chūnin are ordered by the Fifth Hokage to keep an eye out, in case of an attack during the power outage.

In the anime, during the aftermath of Pain's assault on Konoha, he met with his fellow tutors Iruka Umino and Suzume, making preparations to search for and salvage anything that could be used for class.
